goal: Prevent wallet funding from creating transactions that exceed the requested maximum transaction weight
Ensure the configured weight cap is enforced when provided preset inputs already cover the payment amount
agreement: Substantive support with no open objections
Verified by reproducing the bug with legacy inputs and testing the functional test fix (jcastros)

categories.name: wallet
why: P3 because it fixes a bug where wallet funding ignores the caller requested max weight when inputs cover amount
The issue only affects callers specifying max weight with preset inputs that bypass coin selection
